claim: P1 engineering non-inferiority for five normal source-consumer container families against source-pinned Abseil, rigtorp, Boost, and xxHash peers under balanced execution, allocation, and code-placement strata

candidate.entrypoint: hyle/container/small_vector.h, flat_hash_map.h, bounded_queue.h, dynamic_bitset.h, and hash.h

configuration.source: clean external checkout with exact required submodules

configuration.algorithm: rigtorp::mpmc::Queue strict bounded Vyukov MPMC ring

ownership_topology.candidate: Each callback constructs caller-owned HYLE SmallVector<uint32_t,16> batches, appends 4096 total values across inline and spill cases, scans them, and destroys every batch
ownership_topology.peer: Each callback constructs caller-owned Abseil InlinedVector<uint32_t,16> batches with the identical value sequence, inline/spill split, scan, and teardown
ownership_topology.equivalence: Both sides own contiguous growable SBO sequences, use their normal default allocator only for identical spill cases, and charge construction, append, iteration, spill allocation, and destruction

material_contribution.denominator: one callback containing 256 eight-value inline batches and 32 sixty-four-value spill batches
material_contribution.derivation: Graph parallel evaluation repeatedly materializes short level/frontier vectors and occasionally exceeds the inline budget; 4096 elements amortize the timer without changing those ownership phases

workloads.semantic_contract: Build, consume, and destroy a mixed normal batch of inline and spilled uint32_t sequences containing 4096 total elements

input.distribution: runtime array of 64 uint32_t values reused through 256 inline and 32 spill owners

workloads.setup: The common runtime value array exists before measurement; every sequence owner and spill allocation remains inside the charged callback

ownership_topology.candidate: One caller-owned prebuilt HYLE FlatHashMap holds 32768 integral metadata entries at its normal reserved capacity and serves 4096 mixed hit/miss queries
ownership_topology.peer: One caller-owned prebuilt Abseil flat_hash_map holds the identical entries at its normal reserved capacity and serves the identical query stream
ownership_topology.equivalence: Build and allocation are setup-only; both tables own equivalent keys and values, use their production hash/probe policy, expose expected O(1) lookup, and charge only query hashing/probing/equality plus checksum

material_contribution.denominator: one callback containing 2048 hits and 2048 in-domain misses against 32768 entries
material_contribution.derivation: The retained Registry implementation uses FlatHashMap as its frozen name-to-entry index; mixed lookup dominates its normal read path while build and reserve are cold

workloads.semantic_contract: Resolve 4096 deterministic 50-percent-hit integral metadata queries in a prebuilt 32768-entry flat hash index
workloads.setup: Both tables are reserved, populated, and validated outside measurement in controlled allocation order

ownership_topology.candidate: One preallocated HYLE BoundedQueue connects the persistent caller producer to one persistent worker consumer pinned to a distinct same-class physical core
ownership_topology.peer: One preallocated rigtorp MPMCQueue with the same nominal 1024 capacity connects the same persistent caller and worker roles
ownership_topology.equivalence: Both are strict bounded Vyukov-style lock-free rings, carry uint64_t values, allocate once before measurement, transfer exactly 4096 values without loss, and share one busy-pause batch-generation boundary so OS park/unpark policy cannot dominate either queue

material_contribution.denominator: one callback transferring 4096 values through a 1024-slot ring between two persistent cores
material_contribution.derivation: The scheduler's global, pinned, and inline-job queues use this bounded placement-lifetime mechanism; batching amortizes the identical epoch signal while retaining the real producer/consumer queue path

workloads.semantic_contract: Transfer exactly 4096 uint64_t values without loss or duplication from one persistent producer to one persistent consumer through a preallocated strict bounded MPMC ring

input.distribution: ascending values 1 through 4096 with checksum conservation

workloads.setup: Both queues are constructed outside measurement in controlled allocation order; one persistent worker is created and pinned once, then both paths receive 32 paired warmup batches before measurement

ownership_topology.candidate: One caller-owned prebuilt HYLE DynamicBitSet contains a deterministic active-ID mask in 4096 uint64_t blocks
ownership_topology.peer: One caller-owned prebuilt Boost dynamic_bitset with uint64_t blocks contains the identical mask
ownership_topology.equivalence: Both own exactly 262144 logical bits and 32768 payload bytes; allocation and population are setup-only and count scans all blocks with identical value semantics

material_contribution.denominator: one callback counting one 262144-bit dense mask represented by 4096 uint64_t blocks
material_contribution.derivation: The retained package consumer proves the public dense active-ID owner; block aggregation is the natural unit for graph/frontier and dirty-mask scans

workloads.semantic_contract: Count every set bit in one prebuilt deterministic dense active-ID mask containing 4096 uint64_t blocks
workloads.setup: Both bitsets are allocated, populated, and equality-checked outside measurement in controlled allocation order

ownership_topology.candidate: HYLE hash_bytes reads caller-owned varied 64-byte metadata keys with an explicit deterministic table seed and retains no storage
ownership_topology.peer: Upstream XXH3_64bits_withSeed reads the same caller-owned keys with the same seed schedule and retains no storage
ownership_topology.equivalence: Both provide non-cryptographic seeded 64-bit table hashes over the complete byte range; output identity is not required, while bytes, lengths, calls, seed schedule, and observable checksum topology are identical

material_contribution.denominator: one callback hashing 4096 varied 64-byte keys from a 256-key warm metadata working set
material_contribution.derivation: The retained installed consumer uses StringHash in its trusted FlatHashMap; 64-byte varied keys exercise the normal inline medium byte core without a single constant-key cache artifact

workloads.semantic_contract: Compute 4096 seeded non-cryptographic 64-bit table hashes over varied caller-owned 64-byte metadata keys

input.distribution: 256 deterministic varied binary keys revisited for 16 passes with a pass-specific seed

workloads.setup: All key bytes are generated once outside measurement; neither implementation allocates or retains key storage
